Name: Mortar SMAPI Bridge
Author: AlbinoGeek
TagLine: Lets the Mortar mod manager send SMAPI console commands to a running game over a private loopback socket. Installed by Mortar; adds no gameplay.
Description:
## Description
**Mortar SMAPI Bridge** lets the [Mortar](https://github.com/Rethunk-Tech/mortar) mod manager send SMAPI console commands to a running Stardew Valley, so Mortar can reload or configure mods without you typing in the SMAPI console. It adds no gameplay and changes no game content.

## Installation instructions
- If you use Mortar, you do not need to download this: Mortar installs and updates it for you.
- By hand: install SMAPI, then unzip the download into the game's `Mods` folder, so the `MortarSmapiBridge` folder sits inside it.

## Main features
- Runs the SMAPI console commands Mortar sends, exactly as if you typed them in the SMAPI console.
- Optional stream overlay for OBS, off by default; it has its own token and no path to the command channel.
- Listens on `127.0.0.1` only (never the network, never the internet), and every request needs a random token stored in a file only your user can read. It makes no outgoing connections.

## Requirements
- SMAPI 4.5.2 or a later 4.x. On SMAPI 5, or a 4.x whose internal console queue moved, the command channel stays off and logs a warning.
- Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later. The stream overlay runs on 1.6.14 up to, but not including, 1.7; on any other game version it stays off.

## Shout outs
Built on [SMAPI](https://smapi.io) by Pathoschild (LGPL-3.0), which is referenced, not redistributed.
